patterns.note: The site uses a predominantly dark, full-bleed background for content sections, creating an immersive feel, with a contrasting light background for the footer.
Headings are extremely large, bold, and often condensed sans-serif, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
A high-contrast palette of black backgrounds and white text is consistently accented with vibrant, saturated colors like green, pink, yellow, and blue for CTAs, labels, and illustrative elements.

The hero section features a large, central graphic (goggles) that scales or parallaxes out of view as the user scrolls, revealing the main content. A persistent music player UI appears and sticks to the bottom of the viewport after the initial scroll.
Content sections are clearly delineated by full-width background images or videos, often with text overlaid, breaking the page into distinct visual experiences.

technique_notes: The initial hero section features a full-bleed video playing in the background, with large, high-contrast text overlaid. A prominent graphic element (goggles) is positioned centrally and animates out of view with a scaling or parallax effect as the user scrolls.
Content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, maintaining a dynamic scroll experience.
A sticky music player UI appears at the bottom of the screen after a certain scroll depth, providing persistent access to audio controls throughout the site.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and often condensed sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) create strong impact, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons, cards, and image corners have a slight rounded character.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section is very airy, while content sections maintain a comfortable, readable density with generous vertical spacing between elements.

standout: This site stands out with its immersive, dark aesthetic and the prominent, animated mask graphic in the hero, which creates an immediate sense of intrigue and connection to the 'Inner Vision' concept. The persistent, sticky music player also provides a unique, interactive element that reinforces the site's core offering.
